name: Precedence at San Felice Scalo
description: Valle Lauro line, ETCS with the reference onboard and the interlocking trackside. The controlled train breaks down after Ponte Sabato and stays still for 200 s; R 5101, timetabled to leave San Felice Scalo after it, arrives there first and waits on track I. When both want the exit towards Monte Clanio, the rule decides: with «timetable» the interlocking holds R 5101 for the controlled train, timetabled earlier; with «first_come» R 5101 leaves first and, slowed by a traction fault, delays the controlled train behind it.
